references.text: The Lord promises to be a guardian for God's people while they are scattered and to gather them in, an image that Jesus fulfills when he identifies himself as the door to the sheep.
The prophecy that a single shepherd, David, will be shepherd for the people foretells Jesus' role as the one door and the shepherd who leads the sheep.
The psalm describes the Lord as the shepherd who leads the people to safe places, an image Jesus makes concrete by saying he is the door that gives safety and nourishment.
The Lord is described as a shepherd who gathers the lamb in his arms and leads those who are pregnant, a care that Jesus emphasizes by being the only way into the flock.
